profile.headline: Principal Software Developer at Wealthsimple, engineering leadership for distributed apps and distributed teams
profile.geoLocationName: Queens County, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Frequent Elixir, Phoenix, Ecto, and Postgrex contributor. 

Speaker at ElixirConf 2017/2016, and ElixirCamp NYC 2016.

positions.title: Principal Software Developer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Remote

positions.title: Director Of Engineering
positions.description:
Engineering director for NBA InPlay, a real-time fantasy sports game that is designed to be played by 100k+ concurrent users. 

NBA InPlay is implemented using Elixir/Erlang for high performance, high reliability soft-realtime game services via HTTP and WebSockets, and Unity/Xamarin on the client side to provide a high quality native user experience.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Mobile
positions.description:
- Built and maintained the company's Sencha Touch HTML5 mobile app framework (written in CoffeeScript), Phonegap iOS and Android wrappers, Node.js/CoffeeScript/C++ differential app patching web server, and build tooling. Built, maintained, and deployed Node.js app backend in CoffeeScript on Heroku, then migrated to existing C# .Net web infrastructure. Built and maintained implementations of mobile offer applications for Group Commerce clients.

- Built and maintained the company's ad server, written in Haskell with the Snap Framework. Achieved high throughput, durability, reliability, and low latency while communicating with the Group Commerce platform and generating dynamic HTML/JS ads. Wrote extremely optimized javascript to render ad templates in the browser in 363 bytes with an entire templating system. Used Amazon EC2 AutoScaling to enable zero-downtime deployment, 24/7 monitoring and fully-automated instance maintenance.

- Helped lead the company in a source control migration from SVN to Git. Provide and perform presentations, demos, and lessons for development team. Provided day-to-day support for dev team with Git questions and issues.

positions.title: Lead Mobile/Backend Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead developer and maintainer of iOS app framework that was used to launch 20+ Socialight platform apps with a 4 star average rating in the iOS app store.

- Lead developer and maintainer of the Socialight platform (using Ruby on Rails, MySQL, Redis and Sphinx) for location-based content applications.

- In charge of operations. I maintain our linux servers on the Engine Yard cloud, achieving a reputation of high availability and performance.

positions.title: Independent Researcher - REU Program
positions.description: - Devised and implemented (in C++) a novel way to model grid computing resources.

positions.title: Web/Tech Support Consultant
positions.description: - Designed and built an interactive promotional website for use with the EZ-Pass system.

positions.title: Summer Technology Intern
positions.description: - Gained experience in graphic design, programming, information technology, and tech support.

positions.title: News Editor
positions.description: - Wrote original news stories daily from my home office, communicated with members of online gaming communities as a representative of IGN, and created HTML and CSS for site layout.
